title: "Deacon Parameter Search Analysis"
author: "Katelyn Nguyen"
date: "2025-11-13"
output: html_document
---
```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
```

# Load Data
```{r data}
# CHANGE DATA PATH BELOW
deacon_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/deacon_param_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    tool = "deacon",
    param1 = as.character(a),
    param2 = r
  )
biobloom_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/biobloom_param_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    tool = "biobloom",
    param1 = S,
    param2 = s
  )
combined_results <- bind_rows(deacon_results, biobloom_results)

# One label for parameters
# Keep first occurrence of duplicates
combined_results_unique <- combined_results %>%
  distinct(fp, fn, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("(", param1, ",", param2, ")"))

glimpse(combined_results_unique)
```

# Plot FP vs FN
```{r data}
# Plot FP vs FN
ggplot(combined_results_unique, aes(x = fp, y = fn, label = label)) +
geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
geom_text_repel(vjust = -1.6, size = 3, , segment.color = NA) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
labs(
title = "False Positives vs False Negatives",
x = "False Positives (FP)",
y = "False Negatives (FN)",
color = "Tool",
shape = "Tool"
) +
theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 40)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
```

# Plot Runtime
```{r plot2}
ggplot(deacon_results, aes(x = r, y = runtime, color = factor(r))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime vs r (Grouped by a)",
    x = "r parameter",
    y = "Runtime (s)",
    color = "r value"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
